caption: Optional NARMA10 supplement, not part of the active manuscript. Left: actual synthetic target and fitted QRC/QELM predictions, first fresh root 921000, first 96 scored test rows; no smoothing or averaging of different targets. Right: test NRMSE medians and 10th-90th percentiles across all 24 fresh roots, not confidence intervals. Reset/replay restricts the same QRC and refits its readout; longer replay costs more evolution steps. Four-input QELM and four-/twelve-input quadratic controls remain visible. Inputs drive the NARMA recurrence; neither model receives past targets. Exact expectations; no quantum-advantage or worst-case-bound claim.

scope.claims: exact expectations; no quantum advantage, universal superiority or information floor
scope.history: reset same QRC and refit readout; increasing replay uses more evolution steps
scope.interval: 10th-90th percentiles of 24 rootwise scores, not confidence intervals
scope.narma: fresh independent input and coupling roots; no past targets supplied
scope.traces: first fresh root, first 96 scored rows; no smoothing or cross-root averaging

trace.input_units: NARMA recursion drive 0.2*u[t]; hardware receives quantized u[t]

verification.scope: Every stored test score and target; saved-readout/channel reconstruction sampled at five fixed rows per fitted model and cell. Direction checks are separate from verification success, not universal superiority or hardware validation.

laser.scope: Coupling variation conditional on one measured record
